format: CSV with one row per candidate and no duplicate candidate_id

validation_rules.candidate_identity: candidate_id must occur exactly once in the audited label-blind ledger and standardized_inchikey must match
validation_rules.interval: finite lower <= point prediction <= upper, with interval_level exactly 0.90 and a named method plus hashed calibration source
validation_rules.threshold: threshold_pbind_ki exactly 6.7412, operator >=, with a committed derivation artifact and matching SHA-256
validation_rules.artifact_paths: repository-relative, present, and matching their lowercase SHA-256 digests
validation_rules.failure_mode: any missing field, malformed row, unknown candidate, hash mismatch, outcome access, or docking selection rejects the entire artifact

eligibility_semantics.screen_eligible_not_ruled_out: upper_90 >= verified threshold; permissive screening language only
eligibility_semantics.robust_threshold_support: lower_90 >= verified threshold; still not a hit probability or experimental claim
